name: Chandrayaan-1
about: Chandrayaan-1 (2008-052A, ISRO), launched 2008 Oct 22. Its phases from GCAT: Luna. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was
